steps.en: Staff can add another suspension to a suspended notice
steps.id: Staff bisa menambah suspension lagi pada notice yang sudah suspended

steps.en: PLUS can add another suspension to a suspended notice
steps.id: PLUS bisa menambah suspension lagi pada notice yang sudah suspended

steps.en: Existing suspension does not block a new temporary one
steps.id: Suspension yang ada tidak menghalangi suspension sementara baru

steps.en: Different suspension reasons can be applied, each with its own end date
steps.id: Alasan suspension berbeda bisa diterapkan, masing-masing dengan tanggal berakhir sendiri

steps.en: Every suspension is kept as a separate record
steps.id: Setiap suspension disimpan sebagai catatan tersendiri

steps.en: The notice shows the most recent suspension reason
Each suspension ends on its own date; the others stay
steps.id: Tiap suspension berakhir di tanggalnya sendiri; yang lain tetap berlaku
